title: FastPath Entitlement: flexible on-prem bundles, upgrade cadence options, and SQ alignment
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a configurable entitlement offering for Private/VPC and on-prem customers that reduces procurement friction and aligns license fees, support tiers, and upgrade cadences with enterprise security questionnaire (SQ) expectations. Deliver a pricing matrix (banded and seatless options), clear SLA/upgrade windows per support tier, and an SQ mapping document to accelerate legal and procurement cycles.
background: Sales and Solutions Engineering report frequent procurement delays from large customers due to inflexible licensing and upgrade policies. Enterprise customers ask for: (1) deterministic upgrade cadence guarantees, (2) support tiers mapped to response/patch SLAs, and (3) a compact SQ appendix showing encryption, patching, and maintenance practices. Current on-prem offers are one-size-fits-all and cause multi-week contract negotiation for mid-market and enterprise deals.
goals: Reduce average time-to-contract for on-prem deals by 30% within three quarters
Create 3 modular entitlement templates (Core, Business, Enterprise) that sales can present in first meeting
Provide a configurable upgrade cadence option (Optional FastPath: quarterly security patches, Standard: biannual, Conservative: annual) tied to support tier and pricing
Produce an SQ alignment appendix to reduce back-and-forth during procurement
scope: In scope: pricing matrix, support tier definitions, upgrade cadence options, SQ appendix draft, sales one-pager and internal enablement
Out of scope: billing system implementation, legal contract language finalization (Legal will consume produced appendix), engineering runtime changes
proposed_pricing_matrix: Core: license fee = base annual license + optional commit credit; support Tier = Silver (business hours, 48h response); upgrade cadence = Conservative (annual); target customers = SMB and non-regulated

Business: license fee = base + usage band credits (seatless commit bands: 1-10k GPU-hours, 10-50k, 50k+); support Tier = Gold (24x5, 24h response, security patching quarterly opt-in); upgrade cadence = Standard (biannual); target customers = mid-market

Enterprise: license fee = negotiated commit band + platform premium; support Tier = Platinum (24x7, 4h response, dedicated TAM option); upgrade cadence = FastPath (quarterly security patches + out-of-band critical fixes); target customers = regulated/finance/healthcare
success_metrics: Median contract negotiation time for on-prem deals reduced from X days to <= 30 days
Number of deals accepting FastPath option >= 25% of enterprise customers in pilot
Reduction in legal questionnaire back-and-forth cycles measured by SQ iterations per deal <= 2
rollout_plan: Week 1-2: Draft pricing matrix + SQ appendix; align with Legal and Security for redlines
Week 3: Pilot offering with 2 existing enterprise opportunities (Sales to solicit acceptance) and collect feedback
Week 4-6: Iterate pricing and upgrade windows based on pilot; produce sales one-pager and internal enablement kit
Week 7: Release public-facing entitlement options to Enterprise AE motion and include in contract playbook
Post-release: Monitor metrics and adjust bands at quarterly business review
acceptance_criteria: Approved pricing matrix signed off by Head of Revenue and Head of Product
Security and Legal approval on SQ appendix (no more than two redline cycles during signoff)
Sales enablement materials completed and distributed (one-pager, demo scripts, FAQ)
Pilot feedback loop documented with at least two pilot customers and action items tracked
